verdict.rationale: Building native mobile apps is a fair axis for a UI framework, but the evidence only describes Svelte as a framework for building user interfaces on the web. Its outputs are browser JavaScript, SSG, SPA and server-rendered pages, and nothing mentions iOS or Android native targets. The community report of a cross-platform video editor with a Rust backend does not establish native mobile delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reuse my framework skills and code to build performant native mobile apps for iOS and Android
